Summary

The JSON consolidation is now complete. All JSON-specific functions have been removed and their functionality integrated into the base functions:

  • boilerplate_import() - Auto-detects JSON/RDS format
  • boilerplate_save() - Supports format parameter (“json”, “rds”, “both”)
  • boilerplate_export() - Supports format parameter
  • boilerplate_batch_edit() - Can load databases directly from file paths
  • boilerplate_standardise_measures() - Has json_compatible parameter for JSON-specific formatting

The package is now lighter and more economical as requested, with a simpler API that handles both formats seamlessly.

Functions Retained

These JSON utility functions remain as they serve specific purposes: - boilerplate_migrate_to_json() - One-time migration tool - boilerplate_rds_to_json() - Simple format converter - validate_json_database() - JSON schema validation - compare_rds_json() - Format comparison for verification
